name: Shin-Seibijo
tagline: Tokyo in 41 minutes and Shinagawa in 41 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyo Monorail. Journey times to the main business districts are 46 minutes to Otemachi, 55 minutes to Shinjuku, 50 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 5.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 5.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 0.9 m to 9.1 m, a difference of 8.2 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Monorail. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.
